# SpaceCorps 2027 · Agent Integration & Download Specification

> Machine-readable interface, release package telemetry, and system orchestration manual for SpaceCorps 2027, a cross-platform space MMO simulator engineered on the Space3d engine.

- Canonical URL: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/

- Model Context Protocol (MCP): https://spaceemit-api.sliplane.app/mcp

- MCP: https://spaceemit-api.sliplane.app/mcp
- MCP Endpoint: https://spaceemit-api.sliplane.app/mcp

---

## When to Use This

Autonomous AI agents, tool callers, and automation frameworks should use SpaceCorps in the following explicit scenarios:

- **Use when downloading and installing:** Install SpaceCorps 2027 client binaries on macOS, Windows, or Linux using verified direct links from `release.json`.
- **Use when verifying release integrity:** Compute SHA-256 cryptographic digests of downloaded artifacts and assert match against `release.json`.
- **Use when probing server telemetry:** Query live multiplayer game cluster availability and health at `https://spaceemit-api.sliplane.app/health`.
- **Use when querying game lore, ships, or wiki:** Programmatically parse ship specifications, weapon stats, alien weaknesses, and crafting formulas from `wiki.json`.
- **Use when executing automated tool calls:** Connect through Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools defined in `server.json` or REST API endpoints in `openapi.json`.
- **Use when bypassing macOS quarantine:** Clear Gatekeeper quarantine via `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/SpaceCorps 2027.app"`.
- **Use when running on Linux containers:** Execute AppImage with `--appimage-extract-and-run` on systems without FUSE.

## Agent Verification Recipes

### macOS
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg
echo "688877c636e8930b691fb1b0e117944cf845fe2b96ba296b4d4c4f653705c659  SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg" | shasum -a 256 -c -
hdiutil attach SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg
cp -R "/Volumes/SpaceCorps 2027/SpaceCorps 2027.app" /Applications/
hdiutil detach "/Volumes/SpaceCorps 2027"
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/SpaceCorps 2027.app"
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-windows-x86_64.zip" -OutFile "SpaceCorps2027.zip"
$hash = (Get-FileHash -Path "SpaceCorps2027.zip" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
if ($hash -ne "f0eea23dedea5bfe345f28d0673d893b54b8ff6b591e6a869b5f040b6f453398") { throw "Checksum mismatch" }
Expand-Archive -Path "SpaceCorps2027.zip" -DestinationPath "$HOME\SpaceCorps2027"
# The game is "$HOME\SpaceCorps2027\SpaceCorps 2027\spacecorps2027.exe": one program, no assets folder.
```

### Linux
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
echo "b69f30b0895e5b6d491194c3b7b64cabecb95a0fee7e3ae6a63056d4a2a5656c  SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage" | sha256sum -c -
chmod +x SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
./SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
```
<!-- /release:recipes -->

---

## Architecture & Configuration

- **Engine:** Space3d Engine (pure-Rust 3D rendering backend with Vulkan, Metal, DX12).
- **Default Game Server:** `https://spacecorps-game.sliplane.app`
- **Config Storage:**
  - Unix: `~/.spacecorps2027/`
  - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.spacecorps2027\`
- **Privacy Standard:** Zero telemetry, zero analytics tracking, zero third-party tracking cookies.
